slides.title: Is your Team View still right?
slides.support: In Metronome: open Team View. Check it against the Function Chart you just agreed.
body: Which functions are missing, or planned for growth?
Is every function owned by an A-Player?
notes: Put today’s Team View on the screen. Fix any difference from the new Function Chart now, or put it on the homework list.
A person who owns several functions carries a load to watch. A planned function shows where the company will hire or where someone can grow.
The third question connects to the A-Player check later this morning. A function owned by someone below A needs a plan.
Homework: update the Team View in Metronome.
slides.headline: Is your Team View still right?

slides.title: Are your scorecard reviews done?
body: Has your leader reviewed you against your scorecard?
Have you reviewed each of your direct reports against theirs?
notes: The homework from last quarter was to complete annual reviews on the function scorecards in Metronome.
A review is a conversation against the scorecard: the purpose, the accountabilities, the two metrics, the competencies and the Core Values.
This is a check, not a discussion of anyone’s review. Take the dates and move on.
slides.headline: Are your scorecard reviews done?
